risk_notice:
安装 0.1.20 前请删除旧版同名 pakchunk9999-Windows_P.pak。模组更新可能改变原文、key、命名空间或资产路径，导致部分汉化失效；请通过 Issues 附上截图反馈。本项目为玩家自制附加汉化，不替代官方汉化补丁。
Remove the old same-named pakchunk9999-Windows_P.pak before installing 0.1.20. Mod updates can change source text, keys, namespaces, or asset paths. Report reproducible screenshots through Issues. This is a player-made add-on and does not replace the official localization patch.
